_about: Inputs to scripts/affected-rust-packages.py for the pull request tier (see .github/workflows/README.md). Every entry says why it exists in its `why` field.

repo_wide.name: install-wait scan and probe script tests
repo_wide.why: test_budget.py lists every tracked file (git ls-files) and fails when any file installs a chart without the install wait. A new file in any package can break it, so it runs on every pull request. It is the Python half of `cargo test -p alien-helm --test cni_probe`, run directly so no Rust build is needed.

repo_wide.name: release routing and metadata tests
repo_wide.why: These read the release workflows and the package manifests across the repository. They otherwise run only when a release starts.

repo_wide.name: selection script tests
repo_wide.why: The script decides what pull requests test, and this keeps every entry of this file pointing at something that exists. Cheap, and it reads the crates' manifests and test directories.

left_out.@alienplatform/bindings: Its tests load the native addon, which needs a Rust build of alien-bindings-node (minutes). The nightly and release runs test it.

@alienplatform/core.why: packages/core/src/__tests__/platform-binding-serialization.test.ts imports the generated platform client by relative path, and core's generated schemas come from the OpenAPI specs.
